title: Honest work belongs to the spiritual life
summary: Guru cuts through posturing and gives a plain path: labor honestly and share.
takeaway: Truth is lived in how you earn and how you open your hand.
lifeApplication: Let one concrete act of generosity become part of your workday, not separate from it.

source.shortMeaning: The path is recognized in honest labor and generosity.
source.lifeApplication: Do not separate devotion from the ethics of work and giving.

evidence.coreClaim: The path is recognized in honest labor and generosity.
evidence.turn: The path is not performed through appearance. It is walked through honest labor and giving.
evidence.practicalImplication: Let one concrete act of generosity become part of your workday, not separate from it.
